sourceRootResolution: Explicit HtmlForgeXSourceRoot MSBuild property; otherwise EVOTEC_GITHUB_ROOT/HtmlForgeX.
binding: Opt-in ProjectReference; outside the OfficeIMO solution and product runtime dependencies.
scriptFreeEmission: Serialize components without attaching them to a Document. Component ToString output is placed in a local typed HTML shell with embedded fonts and CSS. No library scripts are registered or stripped.

footerBoundaries.Table: Produces thead/tbody/tfoot fragments. One tiny semantic table shell encloses the typed output. Real tfoot repetition is an acceptance target.
footerBoundaries.MonitoringTable: Footer(string) is a terminal sibling div outside the table. It must appear once and is not a repeating row-group footer.
footerBoundaries.MonitoringAlertQueue: No typed footer API. Fixture adds a declared terminal paragraph after the queue. Queue row identifiers are exact visible title labels; no per-row DOM id API exists.

contract.canonicalization: UTF-8 JSON with recursively sorted object keys, original array order, literal non-ASCII characters, no insignificant whitespace, and no trailing newline. The portable file adds one LF after that canonical content.
contract.semanticChange: None. Only formatting and object-key order differ from the original qualified declaration.
contract.declarationBoundary: The report and inventory values predate report rendering. The corrected font profile predates successful managed complete-report rendering.

fontProfile.copyright: Copyright 2013 The Carlito Project Authors (https://github.com/googlefonts/carlito), with Reserved Font Name "Carlito"
fontProfile.inputRootResolution: Explicit --inputs argument; each contract font fileName is relative to that root.
fontProfile.distributionBoundary: Fonts are supplied by the operator and embedded in generated reports; no fonts or other binaries are stored in this producer directory.

outputReceipt: producer-receipt.json binds the actual contract bytes, source-binding manifest bytes, HtmlForgeX assembly identity, and generated HTML hashes.
